dataset.description: The dataset comprises geometry files for low molecular weight compounds related to electron transport and hole transport. These files store information about atoms and bonds. The optimization of molecular geometry is performed using Avogadro software. These molecular structural files can subsequently be utilized to calculate energy levels for molecules, for instance, using Gaussian software.

distribution.title:
The dataset integrates geometry files for studied low molecular weight compounds related to electron transport and hole transport. These files store
information about atoms and bonds. The optimization of molecular geometry is performed using Avogadro software. These molecular structural files can
subsequently be utilized to calculate energy levels for molecules, for instance, using Gaussian software.

The dataset is available from the Zenodo repository
(https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.10875137).
